title: DeepSeek Harness reports 1.54M daily users and 35K plugins
summary: DeepSeek Harness said that as of Nov. 4 it had 1.54 million daily active users, consumed 92.1 trillion tokens per day, and hosted nearly 35,000 third-party plugins; about 60% of active users had used or developed a plugin. The platform also outlined plans to improve plugin API stability, launch an official plugin marketplace, and create an author support program offering token incentives, promotion for creators&\#x27; work, and enterprise commercial partnerships. These figures and initiatives come from the platform&\#x27;s own disclosure and have not been independently verified.
